title: Permission Flags Manager
description:
Simulate file permissions with bit flags.
```
Start:         00000000
+ read:        00000001
+ write:       00000011
+ execute:     00000111
- write:       00000101
toggle hidden: 00001101
can read? true   can write? false   is hidden? true
```
requirements: `constexpr std::uint8_t` flags: read, write, execute, hidden, system
Functions: `std::uint8_t grant(std::uint8_t perms, std::uint8_t flag)`, `revoke`, `toggle`, `bool has(...)`
stretch: print Unix-style `rwx` string using `?:` per flag.
